title: Hester's Remedy
summary: Elsie's hip aches in the damp. Hester knows a remedy, if someone fetches the herbs.

stages.text: Hester needs three sprigs of yarrow from the meadow south-west of the village and two heads of feverfew from the riverbank.
stages.hint: Yarrow grows in small white clusters; feverfew looks like a daisy. Look for them, then pick them.

stages.text: Hester taught you the remedy. It wants a slow fire, and the inn hearth is the warmest in the village.
stages.hint: Use the hearth in the Rain & Lantern's common room.

objectives.text: Prepare the remedy at the inn hearth

stages.text: It smells terrible, which Hester says is a good sign.

completion_text: Elsie's hip is better. Hester taught you how to make a trail tonic.
